answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the grove graph and each risks its bond. Because the cipher release is recorded with every signature, the vertex audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The fee repeats 22 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
